This beta adds an album listening view while preserving the existing metadata editor.

## What's new

- Open an album from the covers, list or Overview to see its artwork, information and tracks.
- Play the album or start from a chosen track. Playback continues through that album using the existing local streaming proxy.
- Browse other albums or open **Edit album** while music keeps playing. The metadata editor, online suggestions, review and save flow remain available.
- Track durations appear when the library provides them. Demo and imported libraries remain local previews with playback disabled.
- No additional queue controls, shuffle, repeat, play reporting or scrobbling are introduced.

## Testing the beta

Before publishing, local validation passed all 88 Python tests and 16 frontend
regressions, lint, script parsing and generated CSS checks. An isolated browser
check covered album navigation, editor access, playback controls, light/dark
themes and mobile layout using simulated APIs and silent audio. Actual account
streaming remains part of your beta testing; it was not exercised on your account.

1. Stop the running Tagcast server by closing its terminal window. Otherwise the start script opens the instance that is already running.
2. Download **Source code (zip)** below and unpack it into a separate folder next to your stable copy.
3. Run the usual start script from that beta folder. The page shows **0.9.0 beta 1** at the top.
4. Check album opening in both cover and list views, playback from a chosen track, automatic next track, browsing during playback, and opening/canceling the editor. Metadata saves still require your review.
5. To return to stable 0.8.1, stop the beta server and start your stable copy.

The beta uses the same account settings folder as stable Tagcast; no settings or library format migration is introduced. If you want separate settings, set `TAGCAST_HOME` to another folder before starting. Sign in separately there, and do not disconnect a shared account just to switch versions.

This is a prerelease. Stable 0.8.1 remains the latest stable release.
